ideas.pitch: A localized health triage and disease outbreak predictor designed for semi-urban and rural communities around Bhilai, featuring local language support and rapid clinical symptom assessment.
ideas.title: Bhilai-Pulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: It follows the exact winning pattern of localized multilingual healthcare accessibility demonstrated by SAGACITY and mediscan-ai, which resonates strongly with regional hackathon judges looking for grassroots impact.

ideas.pitch: A 60-second voice biomarker screening tool optimized for detecting early respiratory conditions prevalent in industrial towns like Bhilai using quick audio diagnostic inputs.
ideas.title: Arogya-Voice
ideas.why_it_could_win: It leverages the grand prize-winning formula of fast voice-based diagnostics seen in Timbre, providing judges with a memorable and novel audio-first tech demo.

ideas.pitch: An interactive clinical training simulator that uses MediaPipe computer vision to track student posture during emergency CPR and evaluates simulated patient interviews.
ideas.title: MediTrain-Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: It replicates the winning architecture of Clinical-Simulator by combining computer vision pose tracking with live scoring, ensuring a high-impact, interactive live demo.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered community coordination platform that connects elderly residents in Bhilai with volunteer drivers for medical appointments and social outings.
ideas.title: ElderLink-Bhilai
ideas.why_it_could_win: It directly implements the grand prize-winning social good model of Outreach, addressing local community challenges with a clear, measurable human impact.

ideas.pitch: A personalized nutrition and wellness assistant tailored for local dietary habits in Chhattisgarh, offering instant meal scanning and localized health guidance.
ideas.title: NutriTrack-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: It builds upon the proven first-prize success of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant, combining everyday practical utility with a slick, working user interface.
